quarantined_leads.lead: Luann Middleton, 72, a former United States Postal Service employee, was convicted by a federal jury in the Eastern District of New York on September 11 of wire fraud after submitting false workers-compensation forms and receiving approximately $900,000 in federal disability benefits over roughly 25 years. Sentencing remains pending, with a possible maximum of 20 years in prison and financial penalties.
